name: recon-sparse-confirmation
notes: Task 4, sparse noisy samples (1 % and 5 % of 10 m nodes; noise 0.25 m, Gaussian covariance with 30 m length). Leave one region out over the six development regions (validation region next in the list); one sampling pattern and noise draw per test region and density. Errors over nodes 8..1016 including the sampled nodes. Neural rows are means over seeds unless named -ensemble. Paired differences are negative when the first method is better; within a region over 16 tiles, across regions over regions.

kriging.covariance: Matern 3/2 variogram fitted on training regions plus the declared noise covariance on the data

model.targetScale: local sigma * (1 + d / 4.0), d = distance to the nearest sample in cells
model.type: U-Net width 32 over the thin-plate fit, plus sample mask, misfit and distance channels

noise.covariance: sigma^2 exp(-d^2 / (2 L^2)), Gaussian-filtered white noise rescaled

thinPlate.rule: lowest validation MAE averaged over densities
thinPlate.solver: conjugate gradients from linear interpolation, rtol 1e-6

split.rule: test region k, validation k+1, train the rest
